semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, cost, types, starting loyalty, presentation and first two ability definitions.
The -8 cost and exact mandatory untargeted opponent first-cast emblem definition.
The exact emblem child and ordinary flat cast-trigger context are admitted.
Unsupported emblem shapes, wrappers, Programs and contexts are rejected after parsing.
Scry keep or bottom pauses the draw; the choice has no public reveal, rejects unauthorized or replayed answers and resumes exactly once after source departure.
Empty and one-card libraries follow the Scry and draw instructions.
A targeted creature returns to its owner even if Jace leaves before resolution.
A stale target incarnation is not returned.
Separate opponents' first spells on another player's turn trigger and are countered without targeting; a second spell resolves.
Casts before the emblem count and the per-player ordinal resets on the next turn.
An uncounterable first spell consumes the opponent's first-cast ordinal.
Multiple emblems and a real cast observer share APNAP staging and controller ordering.
The emblem trigger can itself be countered without undoing the spell's ordinal.
An old cast receipt does not counter the same physical card's later incarnation; a synthetic stack reorder exposes the check.
An ordinary Twincast copy does not produce a cast occurrence or emblem trigger.
A real Preparation copy that is cast has a cast occurrence and is countered.
An unavailable emblem controller's marker, pending order and unbegun trigger are removed.
A surviving controller retains its emblem after the original Jace's owner departs; initial control change is synthetic.
A synthetic spell-controller change does not replace the captured cast occurrence.
Accepted wire-encoded commands reproduce the cast, counter and subsequent action.
